goal.title: FigLock v1: a vault you trust with your own secrets and your agents' tokens
goal.description: Free, open-source, no-backend password and secrets manager on storage the user owns, with agent access approved by biometrics. See docs/prd.md.

projects.title: Setup - org, repo, tracker, local dev
projects.exit: Repo public with CI green, Paperclip seeded, AGENTS.md in place, local toolchain documented.

projects.title: Phase 1 - Core + CLI + local folder storage
projects.exit: Notes imported and found by fuzzy search on two Macs syncing through iCloud Drive.

projects.title: Phase 2 - Agent broker + skill
projects.exit: Claude Code deploys to Vercel and calls GitHub with no token in the transcript.

projects.title: Phase 3 - Desktop app + Google Drive
projects.exit: A Mac and a Windows or Linux machine sync through Google Drive; pairing under a minute.

projects.title: Phase 4 - Web PWA + browser extension
projects.exit: Log in to 20 everyday sites from the extension without opening the app.

projects.title: Phase 5 - iOS, then Android
projects.exit: iOS autofill works, an agent grant is approved from the iPhone, Android reaches parity.

projects.title: Phase 6 - Public release
projects.exit: Audit findings fixed and published; a new user sets up in under 3 minutes.

tasks.title: Reserve the figlock GitHub org name (optional, stays empty for now)
tasks.body: Create the free org at github.com/organizations/plan so nobody else takes the name. The repo stays on the personal account until S14.

tasks.title: Install Paperclip locally (loopback, telemetry off)
tasks.body: DO_NOT_TRACK=1 PAPERCLIP_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npx -y paperclipai@2026.1023.0 onboard --yes --bind loopback --no-install-service. Decide later whether to install it as a background service.

tasks.title: Seed Paperclip: goal, projects, labels, docs, backlog
tasks.body: Load pm/backlog.json: one goal, eight projects, labels, the documents, all tasks with blocked-by links.

tasks.title: Create public repo seemantshekhar43/figlock
tasks.body: Public, default branch main. Push the local folder (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/, pm/, design/).

tasks.title: Repo setup: licenses, community files, templates, labels
tasks.body: LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE, README, SECURITY.md (security@figlock.com, private vulnerability reporting on), CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, issue templates (bug, feature), PR template asking for FIG-<n> and Closes #N, area/type labels matching Paperclip, CODEOWNERS, area/type labels.

tasks.title: Repo protection and security settings
tasks.body: Ruleset on main: PRs only, 1 approval, required CI, linear history, no force push. Dependabot alerts and updates, secret scanning with push protection, CodeQL where supported.

tasks.title: CI skeleton with path filters
tasks.body: Rust workspace with empty crates; GitHub Actions: fmt, clippy -D warnings, test, cargo-deny. Path filters so app and site jobs only run when their folders change.

tasks.title: Local dev setup: toolchains and task runner
tasks.body: mise.toml pins Rust, Node, pnpm; justfile with check, test, fmt, lint; pre-commit hook running fmt and lint; docs/dev-setup.md from a clean Mac. Verify by following the doc in a fresh clone.

tasks.title: Connect Claude Code as a Paperclip agent with a review gate
tasks.body: Agent works in the repo checkout, stops at In Review, follows the start-a-task routine in AGENTS.md (GitHub issue on start, FIG-<n> branch, Closes #N).

tasks.title: Monday progress routine
tasks.body: Weekly routine: done last week, in progress, blocked, plus any task still open whose GitHub issue is closed.

tasks.title: Domain hygiene: DNSSEC, auto-renew, email routing
tasks.body: In Cloudflare: turn on DNSSEC, confirm auto-renew, Email Routing for support@ and security@figlock.com to the owner's inbox.

tasks.title: Hold package names
tasks.body: Placeholder 0.0.0 crates for figlock, figlock-core, figlock-cli on crates.io (needs the owner's crates.io login); create the homebrew-tap repo.

tasks.title: Trademark and store name check for FigLock
tasks.body: Search USPTO, EUIPO and India IP for FigLock in software classes; search App Store and Play Store for the name. Report findings, no filings.

tasks.title: Transfer the repo to the figlock org
tasks.body: When there is something concrete and before the first store or Homebrew release: transfer seemantshekhar43/figlock to figlock, then update AGENTS.md, crates.io repository fields, the Homebrew tap and Paperclip workspace settings; re-check Actions secrets, Pages and rulesets.

tasks.title: Install OpenDesign and connect Claude Code
tasks.body: Install the desktop app from GitHub Releases or open-design.ai; connect Claude Code via the MCP snippet in Settings. Product analytics off; sample data only.
